name: Dos Caminos Pipeline / Spears Expansion Project (Howard Energy Partners)
researcher_notes: Not in the roster: no row for Dos Caminos or Spears; Nueva Era (P0290) is a separate border line and P0224 NET Mexico is a different system. Kinder Morgan's 67-mile 42-inch Eagle Ford line to Sinton is a separate project, not this row. Kinder Morgan and Howard Energy Partners press release of July 2023 describes Dos Caminos building about 62 miles of 36-inch pipe plus compression, treating and dehydration from Webb County to the Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline station at Freer, to deliver nearly 2 Bcf/d with the Tejas line. EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 1095, lists Spears Expansion Project, Dos Cominos LLC (spelled so by EIA), New Pipeline, Completed 10 Nov 2023, 51 mi, 36 in, 1000 MMcf/d, intrastate, source Howard Energy Partners press release. The April 2024 release row 887 says the same. The July 2023 release row 98 had 62 mi and 2000 MMcf/d at the announced stage; staged the completed figures (51 mi, 1000 MMcf/d) and the 62 mi announced length is a conflict to check. 51 mi is about 82 km, above the 25 km add threshold. Gathering vs transmission: it is a 36-inch intrastate trunk that moves gas to a Kinder Morgan transmission hub for Gulf Coast power, industrial and LNG buyers, so staged as transmission; the Texas Railroad Commission T-4 permit was not checked. EIA names the Dos Caminos partner as NextEra Energy while the press release names an affiliate of Eagle Ford Midstream LP, so Owner is staged as Dos Caminos LLC only and Parent is left blank. EIA and the press release are not fully independent since EIA cites the operator release. Route: no official GIS found, none fabricated. Tier medium. Expansion-row shape: parent system name is the Dos Caminos line itself since no GEM parent exists.
